blocks.zh: 84 惰性淋巴瘤 — Yasmina Serroukh 和 Silvia Montoto

blocks.en: Author affiliations: Yasmina Serroukh — Department of Haematology, Erasmus Medical Center Cancer Institute, University Medical Center Rotterdam, Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Silvia Montoto — Department of Haemato-Oncology, St. Bartholomew’s Hospital, Barts Health NHS Trust, London, UK (s.montoto@qmul.ac.uk).

blocks.en: 84.1 Definition and Epidemiology Indolent lymphomas (iNHL) are mature small B-cell neoplasms that include but are not limited to follicular lymphoma (FL), marginal zone lymphoma (MZL) and lymphoplasmocytic lymphoma (LPL) as defined by the WHO and ICC classifications (Alaggio et al. 2022; Campo et al.
blocks.zh: 84.1 定義與流行病學 惰性淋巴瘤（iNHL）是成熟小 B 細胞腫瘤，包括但不限於 WHO 與 ICC 分類所定義的濾泡性淋巴瘤（FL）、邊緣區淋巴瘤（MZL）及淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤（LPL）（Alaggio et al. 2022；Campo et al.

blocks.en: 2022). This heterogenous group accounts for 1/3 of all malignant lymphoma with FL being the most common subtype (Al-Hamadani et al.
blocks.zh: 2022）。此異質性疾病群約占所有惡性淋巴瘤的 1/3，其中 FL 為最常見亞型（Al-Hamadani et al.

blocks.en: 2015). iNHL are characterized by repeated relapses, with autologous (auto) and allogeneic (allo) HCT being the only curative options. The largest studies on HCT for iNHL included a majority of FL patients (Montoto et al. 2013), thus these strategies are detailed here specifically for FL unless otherwise specified and can be extrapolated for the other subtypes. The roles of both forms of HCT are evolving and have recently been challenged as T-cell engaging therapies emerge. The current indications for auto-HCT and allo-HCT are reviewed below.
blocks.zh: 2015）。iNHL 以反覆復發為特徵，自體與異體 HCT 是僅有的治癒性選項。iNHL 的 HCT 大型研究多以 FL 患者為主（Montoto et al. 2013），因此以下策略主要針對 FL；除非另有說明，也可外推至其他亞型。隨著 T 細胞接合治療出現，自體與異體 HCT 的角色持續演變並受到挑戰。以下回顧目前自體 HCT 與異體 HCT 的適應症。

blocks.en: 84.2 Diagnosis The diagnosis of iNHL relies on the pathological findings on a surgical/excisional biopsy. The staging and assessment of response rely on, ideally, positron emission tomography (PET) scan or computed tomography (CT) scan.
blocks.zh: 84.2 診斷 iNHL 的診斷依賴手術/切除活檢的病理結果。理想情況下，反應的分期和評估依賴於正子斷層掃描 (PET) 掃描或電腦斷層掃描 (CT) 掃描。

blocks.en: 84.3 Prognosis The most frequently used prognostic score is the FLIPI (Dreyling et al. 2021). Patients that relapse within 2 years of the first-line therapy (Casulo et al. 2015) and those with high-grade transformation at relapse (Sarkozy et al. 2016) have been shown to have poor survival, and these patients should be considered for a HCT procedure once adequate disease control has been obtained.
blocks.zh: 84.3 預後 最常用的預後分數是 FLIPI (Dreyling et al. 2021)。一線治療後 2 年內復發的患者 (Casulo et al. 2015) 和復發時發生高度轉化的患者 (Sarkozy et al. 2016) 已被證明生存率較差，一旦獲得足夠的疾病控制，這些患者應考慮進行 HCT 手術。

blocks.en: Patients with a high FLIPI score at relapse and those with multiple relapses may also have a poor prognosis, and these patients may also be considered for transplant options. It is important, however, to carefully counsel the patients regarding both the transplant and non-transplant therapies that are currently available of which there are many (Dreyling et al. 2021; Kuruvilla 2016).
blocks.zh: 復發時FLIPI評分較高的患者以及多次復發的患者也可能預後較差，這些患者也可能會考慮移植選擇。然而，重要的是，要仔細向患者提供有關目前可用的移植和非移植療法的建議（Dreyling et al. 2021；Kuruvilla 2016）。

blocks.en: 84.4 First Line Treatment First-line therapy for patients with advanced stage iNHL in need of treatment is to administer chemoimmunotherapy followed by maintenance with the chosen monoclonal antibody (Rituximab or Obinutuzumab) (Dreyling et al. 2021). There is no place for auto or allo HCT in first-line therapy.
blocks.zh: 84.4 第一線治療 需要治療的晚期 iNHL 患者，第一線通常採化學免疫治療，之後以所選單株抗體（rituximab 或 obinutuzumab）維持（Dreyling et al. 2021）。自體或異體 HCT 在第一線治療中沒有角色。

blocks.en: 84.5 Treatment at First Relapse and Beyond At relapse, standard of care options include chemo-immunotherapy, Rituximab in combination with lenalidomide and consolidation of the response with autologous or allogeneic HCT (Dreyling et al. 2021; Ghione et al. 2023).
blocks.zh: 84.5 首次復發時及以後的治療 復發時，標準護理選擇包括化療免疫療法、利妥昔單抗聯合來那度胺以及用自體或異體 HCT 鞏固療效（Dreyling 等人，2021 年；Ghione 等人，2023 年）。

blocks.en: Inclusion in clinical studies should always be considered. Ongoing clinical trials will clarify the role of CAR-T cells (Jacobson et al. 2022; Fowler et al. 2022; Morschhauser et al. 2023) and bispecific antibodies (Budde et al. 2022) in the therapeutic algorithm of iNHL.
blocks.zh: 應一律考慮納入臨床研究。進行中的臨床試驗將釐清 CAR T 細胞（Jacobson et al. 2022；Fowler et al. 2022；Morschhauser et al. 2023）與雙特異性抗體（Budde et al. 2022）在 iNHL 治療流程中的角色。

blocks.en: 84.6 Autologous HCT
blocks.zh: 84.6 自體 HCT

blocks.en: 84.6.1 Indication Auto-HCT should be considered for iNHL patients with relapsed disease responding to second (or subsequent) line reinduction therapy.
blocks.zh: 84.6.1 適應症 對第二線（或後續）再誘導治療有反應的復發 iNHL 患者，應考慮自體 HCT。

blocks.en: 84.6.2 Recommendations There is a wide variety of different conditioning regimens that may be employed for auto-HCT in FL but a paucity of randomised trials comparing the efficacy and toxicity of the different regimens. The BEAM (BCNU, Etoposide, Ara-C, Melphalan) regimen has become one of the most widely used conditioning regimens for patients with lymphoma. A number of investigators have looked to improve upon BEAM by including Rituximab (R) and dexamethasone, or substituting BCNU with bendamustine which could be even effective but less toxic (Lachance et al.
blocks.zh: 84.6.2 建議 FL 自體 HCT 可採多種預處理方案，但直接比較不同方案療效與毒性的隨機試驗很少。BEAM（BCNU、etoposide、Ara-C、melphalan）已成為淋巴瘤最常用的預處理方案之一。研究者曾嘗試在 BEAM 加入 rituximab（R）與 dexamethasone，或以 bendamustine 取代 BCNU；後者可能同樣有效且毒性較低（Lachance et al.

blocks.en: 2023; Visani et al. 2014).
blocks.zh: 2023；Visani et al. 2014）。

blocks.en: The EBMT-LYM-1 study prospectively examined the role of purging with R pre-HCT in R-naïve patients with relapsed FL (Pettengell et al. 2013). In this study, no benefit could be demonstrated for in vivo purging. The same study demonstrated that R maintenance post-HCT resulted in a prolonged PFS. However, it is unclear how to extrapolate these findings to R-exposed patients.
blocks.zh: EBMT-LYM-1 研究前瞻性地研究了 HCT 前使用 R 淨化對未接受 R 的複發性 FL 患者的作用（Pettengell 等，2013）。在這項研究中，沒有證明體內淨化有任何好處。同一項研究表明，HCT 後維持 R 可以延長 PFS。然而，目前尚不清楚如何將這些發現推斷至 R 暴露患者。

blocks.en: • BEAM is amongst the most frequently used conditioning regimen but other regimens can be used.
blocks.zh: • BEAM 是最常用的調理方案之一，但也可以使用其他方案。

blocks.en: • There is no proven role for purging strategies.
blocks.zh: • 清除策略的作用尚未被證實。

blocks.en: 84.6.3 Expectable Results Auto-HCT achieves a 10-year PFS of approximately 50% and may be curative in a proportion of patients.
blocks.zh: 84.6.3 預期結果 自體 HCT 可達約 50% 的 10 年 PFS，並可能治癒部分患者。

blocks.en: The CUP trial is the only randomised study comparing consolidation with an auto-HCT (using purged or unpurged stem cells) with no further therapy in the relapse setting (Schouten et al. 2003) and included 140 patients with relapsed FL. The 2-year PFS for the chemotherapy alone arm was 26% compared with 58% and 55% for those receiving HCT with either purged or unpurged stem cells, respectively. In addition, there was an OS advantage in favour of the two transplant arms (Schouten et al. 2003). A number of other studies have also reported long-term followup of auto-HCT in relapsed FL and describe a 10-year PFS ranging between 31 and 50% (Kornacker et al. 2009; Montoto et al. 2007; Pettengell et al. 2021). Taken together, these results demonstrate that between 25 and 50% of patients experience prolonged PFS following an auto-HCT for relapsed FL, suggesting that this is a curative procedure for a proportion of patients.
blocks.zh: CUP 試驗是復發情境中唯一比較自體 HCT 鞏固（使用淨化或未淨化幹細胞）與不再治療的隨機研究（Schouten et al. 2003），共納入 140 名復發 FL 患者。單純化療組 2 年 PFS 為 26%，淨化與未淨化幹細胞 HCT 組分別為 58% 與 55%；兩個移植組另有 OS 優勢（Schouten et al. 2003）。其他復發 FL 自體 HCT 長期追蹤研究報告 10 年 PFS 為 31–50%（Kornacker et al. 2009；Montoto et al. 2007；Pettengell et al. 2021）。整體而言，25–50% 患者可在復發 FL 自體 HCT 後獲得長期 PFS，顯示此程序可治癒部分患者。

blocks.en: It is important to recognise both the acute and long-term toxicities associated with auto- HCT. Whilst early TRM may be relatively low in younger patients, there is evidence that for
blocks.zh: 必須辨識自體 HCT 相關的急性與長期毒性。年輕患者的早期 TRM 可能較低，但有證據顯示，對於

blocks.en: patients over the age of 60, the TRM may be in excess of 10% (Sánchez-Ortega et al. 2016).
blocks.zh: 60 歲以上患者，TRM 可能超過 10%（Sánchez-Ortega et al. 2016）。

blocks.en: Given that the median age of patients with relapsing FL is 69 an auto-HCT might be associated with a significant TRM for some patients. An additional concern is the late risk of developing secondary malignancies including MDS/ AML. In a prospective randomised study, patients undergoing an auto-HCT for FL had a significantly higher rate of both solid malignancies and MDS/AML compared to patients not receiving HCT (Gyan et al. 2009). Notably, the conditioning regimen used in this study was total body irradiation, which possibly increases the risk of secondary myeloid malignancies. (Baker et al.
blocks.zh: 鑑於復發性 FL 患者的中位年齡為 69 歲，自體 HCT 可能與某些患者的顯著 TRM 相關。另一個擔憂是發展繼發性惡性腫瘤（包括 MDS/AML）的晚期風險。在一項前瞻性隨機研究中，與未接受 HCT 的患者相比，接受自體 HCT 治療 FL 的患者實體惡性腫瘤和 MDS/AML 的發生率顯著較高（Gyan 等，2009）。值得注意的是，本研究中使用的預處理方案是全身照射，這可能會增加繼發性骨髓惡性腫瘤的風險。 （貝克等人。

blocks.en: 2019) Evaluation of the BM for clonal hematopoiesis and cytogenetic abnormalities may enable the identification of patients at a greater risk of developing MDS/AML following an auto- HCT. For these patients, alternative relapse therapies may be more suitable.
blocks.zh: 2019) 對 BM 的克隆造血和細胞遺傳學異常進行評估可能有助於識別在自體 HCT 後發生 MDS/AML 風險較高的患者。對於這些患者，替代性復發療法可能更合適。

blocks.en: 84.7 Allogeneic HCT In comparison with auto-HCT, allo-HCT offers the provision of a graft uncontaminated by lymphoma cells or exposed to mutagenic agents and the development of an allogeneic GVL effect.
blocks.zh: 84.7 異體 HCT 與自體 HCT 相比，異體 HCT 提供的移植物不受淋巴瘤細胞污染或暴露於誘變劑，並產生同種異體 GVL 效應。

blocks.en: The curative potential of allo-HCT for indolent lymphoma is established (Peniket et al. 2003; van Besien et al. 2003).
blocks.zh: 異體 HCT 對惰性淋巴瘤的治療潛力已得到證實（Peniket 等人，2003 年；van Besien 等人，2003 年）。

blocks.en: 84.7.1 Indication Allo-HCT should only be considered in selected patients with relapsed disease.
blocks.zh: 84.7.1 適應症 異體 HCT 僅應考慮用於選定的疾病復發患者。

blocks.en: Numerous factors have to be taken into consideration when selecting patients for an allo- HCT procedure. Patient-related factors such as age, comorbidities, performance status, organ function, the HCT comorbidity index (HCT-CI)
blocks.zh: 選擇患者進行異體 HCT 手術時必須考慮許多因素。病患相關因素，如年齡、共病、體能狀態、器官功能、HCT 合併症指數 (HCT-CI)

blocks.en: (Sorror et al. 2005) and patients’ personal views will determine if a patient is fit to undergo a transplant and what the likely TRM rate will be.
blocks.zh: （Sorror et al. 2005）和患者的個人觀點將決定患者是否適合接受移植以及可能的 TRM 率是多少。

blocks.en: Allo-HCT should only be considered in patients where the lymphoma is considered to considerably shorten survival. Relapses after three lines of treatment and especially after auto-HCT are reasonable indications for allo-HCT.
blocks.zh: 異體 HCT 僅應在淋巴瘤被認為會顯著縮短存活期的患者中考慮。第三線治療後復發，尤其是自體 HCT 後復發是異體 HCT 的合理指徵。

blocks.en: 84.7.2 Recommendations
• Matched sibling, matched unrelated, haploidentical and cord blood stem cell sources may be considered.
blocks.zh: • 可以考慮配對的兄弟姊妹、配對的無關、單倍體和臍帶血幹細胞來源。

blocks.en: • Reduced intensity conditioning regimens are most appropriate for older patients with significant comorbidities. Young fit patients may be considered for more intensive regimens.
blocks.zh: • 降低強度的調理方案最適合患有嚴重合併症的老年患者。年輕健康的患者可以考慮接受更強化的治療方案。

blocks.en: • There is no preferred GVHD prophylaxis.
blocks.zh:
• 沒有首選的 GVHD 預防方法。
可採用

blocks.en: T-cell depletion may be employed but should be combined with chimerism directed donor lymphocyte infusions.
blocks.zh: T 細胞去除，但應與嵌合定向供體淋巴細胞輸注相結合。

blocks.en: • There is no indication for maintenance therapy post allo-HCT for iNHL.
blocks.zh: • 對於 iNHL，異體 HCT 後沒有維持治療的指徵。

blocks.en: It is unclear whether a reduced intensity conditioning (RIC) or a myeloablative conditioning (MAC) allo-HCT offers superior outcomes in FL. A retrospective registry study demonstrated that the two approaches to allo-HCT resulted in similar outcomes in the sibling donor setting (3-year OS for the MAC and RIC were 71% and 62% (P = 0.15), respectively) (Hari et al. 2008).
blocks.zh: 目前尚不清楚降低強度調節 (RIC) 或清髓性調節 (MAC) 異體 HCT 是否能在 FL 中提供更好的結果。一項回顧性註冊研究表明，兩種異體 HCT 方法在兄弟供者環境中產生了相似的結果（MAC 和 RIC 的 3 年 OS 分別為 71% 和 62%（P = 0.15））（Hari 等人，2008）。

blocks.en: However, the EBMT reported that in the unrelated donor setting, RIC allo-HCT was associated with a lower NRM and significantly longer PFS and OS when compared with MAC allo-HCT (Avivi et al. 2009). The median age at relapse of FL is 69, and therefore the majority of patients that may be considered for an allo-HCT will be considered too old for MAC regimens, and many authorities therefore recommend a RIC allo- HCT for FL.
blocks.zh: 然而，EBMT 報告稱，在不相關的捐贈者環境中，與 MAC 異體 HCT 相比，RIC 異體 HCT 與較低的 NRM 以及顯著較長的 PFS 和 OS 相關（Avivi 等，2009）。 FL 復發的中位年齡為 69 歲，因此大多數可能考慮接受 異體 HCT 的患者被認為對於 MAC 方案來說年齡太大，因此許多權威機構建議對 FL 進行 RIC 異體 HCT。

blocks.en: The outcomes of both matched sibling donor (MSD) and MUD allo-HCT in FL are broadly similar. A recent large retrospective study conducted by the EBMT and the CIBMTR demonstrated that the PFS and OS following MSD and MUD were similar (Sureda et al. 2018). For patients lacking a MSD or MUD, either a cord blood or haploidentical family donor may be considered. The feasibility of umbilical cord blood
blocks.zh: 匹配的兄弟姐妹捐贈者 (MSD) 和 MUD 異體 HCT 在 FL 中的結果大致相似。 EBMT 和 CIBMTR 最近進行的一項大型回顧性研究表明，MSD 和 MUD 後的 PFS 和 OS 相似（Sureda 等人，2018）。對於缺乏 MSD 或 MUD 的患者，可以考慮臍帶血或半相合家族捐贈者。臍帶血的可行性

blocks.en: (Rodrigues et al. 2009; Brunstein et al. 2009) and haplo-HCT (with PT-CY) (Dietrich et al. 2016) in NHL (including FL) has been reported.
blocks.zh: （Rodrigues 等人，2009 年；Brunstein 等人，2009 年）和單倍體 HCT（與 PT-CY）（Dietrich 等人，2016 年）在 NHL（包括 FL）中已有報導。

blocks.en: T-cell depletion of the graft is a wellestablished method to reduce the incidence of GVHD post-transplant but runs the risk of eliminating allo-reactive T cells that will mediate the GVL effect and consequently result in a higher relapse rate. The risk of relapse may be offset by employing donor lymphocyte infusion (DLI), and with this approach, the 4 years PFS and relapse risk were 76% and 24%, respectively, and the incidence of GVHD was low (Thomson et al.
blocks.zh: 移植物的 T 細胞耗竭是一種降低移植後 GVHD 發生率的行之有效的方法，但存在消除同種異體反應性 T 細胞的風險，而同種異體反應性 T 細胞會介導 GVL 效應，從而導致更高的複發率。採用供體淋巴球輸注（DLI）可以抵消復發風險，採用此方法，4年無惡化存活期（PFS）及復發風險分別為76%及24%，且GVHD發生率較低（Thomson等，2017）。

blocks.en: 2010), suggesting that this approach may also be an option for allo-HCT in iNHL.
blocks.zh: 2010），顯示這種方法也可能是 iNHL 中異基因 HCT 的一種選擇。

blocks.en: 84.7.3 Expectable Results Early studies employed MAC regimens and demonstrated that cure could be achieved in a significant proportion of patients. In retrospective studies comparing allo- with auto-HCT, MAC allo-HCT was associated with a lower relapse rate but a higher TRM and consequently a similar OS. In an attempt to reduce the toxicity of allo- HCT, RIC allo-HCT has been developed (Robinson et al. 2002). A number of groups have demonstrated the safety and efficacy of RIC allo- HCT and demonstrated that this type of transplant may be employed in older patients with significant comorbidities and in those patients who have undergone a prior auto-HCT.
blocks.zh: 84.7.3 預期結果 早期研究採用 MAC 方案並證明很大一部分患者可以治癒。在比較異基因 HCT 和自體 HCT 的回顧性研究中，MAC 異基因 HCT 與較低的復發率相關，但 TRM 較高，因此具有相似的 OS。為了減少 異體 HCT 的毒性，開發了 RIC 異體 HCT（Robinson 等，2002）。許多研究小組已經證明了 RIC 異體 HCT 的安全性和有效性，並證明這種類型的移植可用於患有嚴重合併症的老年患者以及先前接受過自體 HCT 的患者。

blocks.en: The largest series of patients undergoing a RIC allo-HCT after the failure of a auto-HCT was reported by the EBMT. The NRM at 2 years was significant (27%), but the 5-year PFS and OS were 48% and 51%, respectively (Robinson et al. 2016).
blocks.zh: EBMT 報告了在自體 HCT 失敗後接受 RIC 異體 HCT 的最大系列患者。 2 年時的 NRM 非常顯著 (27%)，但 5 年 PFS 和 OS 分別為 48% 和 51%（Robinson 等，2016）。

blocks.en: The duration of response following the allo-HCT was also significantly longer than after the auto- HCT illustrating the potential of the allogeneic GVL effect in this disease. This data demonstrates that a RIC allo-HCT can act as an effective salvage strategy in this setting although the toxicity was significant. There is also a risk that patients may fail to respond to reinduction therapy, and therefore would not be eligible for an allo-HCT.
blocks.zh: 異體 HCT 後的反應時間也顯著長於自體 HCT 後，顯示同種異體 GVL 效應在此疾病中的潛力。這些數據表明，儘管毒性很大，但 RIC 異體 HCT 在這種情況下可以作為有效的挽救策略。也存在患者可能對再誘導治療無反應的風險，因此不符合異體 HCT 的資格。

blocks.en: 84.8 The Place of Auto- and Allo- HCT in the Therapeutic Algorithm of iNHL
blocks.zh: 84.8 自體與異體 HCT 在 iNHL 治療演算法中的地位

blocks.en: • Only patients with (a) early relapse or (b) high-grade transformation after first-line therapy or (c) multiple relapses should be considered for HCT consolidation.
blocks.zh: • 只有出現(a) 早期復發或(b) 一線治療後高度轉化或(c) 多次復發的患者才應考慮進行HCT 鞏固治療。

blocks.en: • Auto-HCT may cure some patients and is associated with lower toxicity compared to allo-HCT.
blocks.zh: • 自體HCT 可以治癒一些患者，並且與異體 HCT 相比毒性較低。

blocks.en: • RIC allo-HCT is a curative option for patients that relapse after an auto-HCT.
blocks.zh: • RIC 異體 HCT 是自體 HCT 後復發患者的一種治療選擇。

blocks.en: • Most European authorities recommend auto- HCT as the first transplant of choice and reserve allo-HCT for patients relapsing after an auto-HCT. However, some EBMT centres propose allo-HCT as first transplant in selected cases of relapsed iNHL (Robinson et al. 2013).
blocks.zh: • 多數歐洲專家建議以自體 HCT 作為首選移植，異體 HCT 則保留給自體 HCT 後復發者；但部分 EBMT 中心會在特定復發 iNHL 病例中，將異體 HCT 作為首次移植（Robinson et al. 2013）。

blocks.en: 84.10 Conclusions Both auto- and allo-HCT have an established role in the treatment of relapsed iNHL, and both forms of transplant can deliver curative therapy to patients with otherwise poor prognosis disease. Patient selection for transplant therapy is critical, and a current understanding of the rapidly evolving field of alternative non-transplant lymphoma therapies is mandatory. The treatment paradigm for iNHL evolves rapidly as novel agents are incorporated into clinical practice, and the place of these agents relative to transplantation is likely to change soon.
blocks.zh: 84.10 結論 自體 HCT 和異體 HCT 在復發性 iNHL 的治療中均具有明確的作用，並且兩種形式的移植均可為預後不良的患者提供治癒性治療。移植治療的患者選擇至關重要，並且必須了解目前快速發展的非移植淋巴瘤替代療法領域。隨著新型藥物融入臨床實踐，iNHL 的治療模式迅速發展，這些藥物相對於移植的地位可能很快就會改變。
